messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":3,"verses":[{"chapter":3,"verse":6,"text":"6 Then Jeremiah spoke, saying: “I beg you, Lord, allow me to speak in your presence.”"},{"chapter":3,"verse":7,"text":"7 And the Lord said: “Speak, my chosen one Jeremiah.”"},{"chapter":3,"verse":8,"text":"8 And Jeremiah said: “Lord, now we know that you are handing the city over to its enemies, and they will take the people away to Babylon."},{"chapter":3,"verse":9,"text":"9 What do you want me to do with the holy vessels of the temple service?”"},{"chapter":3,"verse":10,"text":"10 And the Lord said to him: “Take them and entrust them to the earth, saying: ‘Hear, Earth, the voice of your creator who formed you in the abundance of waters, who sealed you with seven seals for seven epochs, and after this you will receive your ornaments."}],"book_code":"4BAR"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 6,7,8,9,10 in this chapter.
